title: Texas 13th Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for Texas's 13th Congressional District pits incumbent Republican Rep. Ronny Jackson against Democratic challenger Mark Nair. The district spans the Texas Panhandle including Amarillo, Wichita Falls, and parts of Denton County, and is rated 'Solid Republican' by the Cook Political Report with a PVI of R+23. Jackson, a retired Navy rear admiral and former White House physician, has held the seat since 2021 and won the 2026 Republican primary with 89.5% of the vote against Chasity Wedgeworth. Nair, a former Amarillo City Council member and entrepreneur, ran unopposed in the Democratic primary and is campaigning on a 'People First' agenda focused on healthcare, housing affordability, and economic fairness in a district that has not elected a Democrat to Congress since the early 1990s.
polling_note: No district-specific public opinion polls were found for the TX-13 general election matchup. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Solid Republican,' and a Texas A&M University/ReconMR June 2026 generic ballot poll showed Republicans leading 49% to 43% statewide, but no candidate-specific polling for this district was identified.

candidates.name: Ronny Jackson
candidates.summary: Ronny Jackson is the incumbent U.S. Representative for Texas's 13th Congressional District, first elected in 2020. A retired U.S. Navy rear admiral and medical doctor, he served as Physician to the President under both Barack Obama and Donald Trump, and as Assistant to the President and Chief Medical Advisor under Trump. He sits on the House Armed Services, Agriculture, Foreign Affairs, and Intelligence committees and won his 2026 primary with 89.5% of the vote.

candidates.name: Mark Nair
candidates.summary: Mark Nair is the Democratic nominee for Texas's 13th Congressional District. A former Amarillo City Council member (2015-2017), he is an entrepreneur, inventor, and educator who teaches coding at Ascension Academy. Nair holds a B.A. and M.A. from Texas A&M University and has worked in technology startups, digital media, and as a mentor for the Texas Tech Innovation Hub and the National Science Foundation. He campaigns on a 'People First' platform supporting universal healthcare, affordable housing, public education investment, and immigration reform.

forecast.rationale: No district-specific public polling exists for this general election matchup, which constrains confidence to 'low' despite strong structural factors. TX-13 is rated Solid Republican by Cook with a PVI of R+23, and has not elected a Democrat to Congress since the early 1990s. Incumbent Ronny Jackson won his primary with 89.5%, demonstrating strong intraparty support. While Democratic nominee Mark Nair is a credible former Amarillo City Council member, the district's deeply Republican partisan lean, incumbency advantage, and absence of any recent Democratic competitiveness in the district indicate an overwhelming Republican advantage. The margin estimate reflects the district's strong Republican skew based on historical voting patterns.
